title: Philips 75PUS8505/12 (75" 4K UHD LED, 3-sided Ambilight, "The One", 2020 model), Czech Republic
notes:
Philips 75PUS8505/12 (75" 4K UHD LED, 3-sided Ambilight, "The One", 2020 model), Czech Republic
Android TV 12 (API 31), firmware STT2.230526.001, security patch 2025-11-01
ro.product.model=TPM191E  ro.product.device=PH9M_EA_5599
Fingerprint: Philips/PH9M_EA_5599/PH9M_EA_5599:12/STT2.230526.001/4215:user/release-keys
TP Vision build: MediaTek MT5887, 2 GB RAM, armeabi-v7a only. Vendor packages use the org.droidtv
prefix. The 2020 sets got this Android 12 firmware (211.x) in 2025; nothing here was checked on
the earlier Android 9/10 firmware.

Same board AND firmware build as examples/philips-tpm191e (identical fingerprint), with another
owner's choices: DLNA stays here because Média binds it; Alexa, the e-sticker, Fitness Buddy and
Apple TV are off; and org.droidtv.fastip goes to DO NOT DISABLE, the SOURCES drawer dies without
it. Every entry was checked on this TV with dumpsys package and dumpsys activity services. The
org.droidtv layer is also shared with examples/philips-50pus8517 (PH1M_EA_9970A, Android 11).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/philips-75pus8505/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/philips-75pus8505/debloat.txt com.google.android.tvlauncher
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher
Live TV app:    org.droidtv.playtv

Already disabled out of the box on a Czech unit, so NOT in this list (restore.sh would turn them
on): Netflix, Prime Video, Play Games, org.droidtv.freeviewplayers and 15 uk.co.freeview.* apps.

Launcher handover, two things that differ from the script's assumptions on this TV:
1. The first cold start of the freshly installed, not yet compiled launcher takes longer than the
10 s `am start -W` waits on this 32-bit MT5887, so build-and-install.sh stops with
"Status: timeout" although the launcher came up fine (it was the resumed activity and drew its
first screen). The remaining steps (pm grant, cmd package compile -m speed, set-home-activity)
were run by hand. Updating the already installed launcher later started in 2.2 s and the
script ran through on its own.
2. The stock launcher's HOME filter has priority=2, a third-party launcher's always 0, and Android
picks the higher priority before it looks at the preferred activity. So with the stock launcher
still enabled, set-home-activity succeeds and the HOME role moves to com.gathin.tvhome, yet the
Home key still opens com.google.android.tvlauncher. The new launcher only takes over once the
stock one is disabled, as note 3 in examples/philips-55oled707 found on the Android 11 board.

After each batch: logcat -c, 30 s of an idle TV, logcat -d, then group lines by shape and look
for anything repeating several times a second (see quirk 5 in examples/philips-50pus8517). The
only loop on this TV before and after is adbd retrying the USB gadget about once a second while
USB debugging is on; it is not caused by the debloat.
A soundbar on HDMI ARC that goes to standby on its own silence timer sends <Set System Audio Mode>
off and <Terminate ARC>, and the TV shows "TV reproduktory aktivní" (TV speakers active). With
Home on screen and nothing playing that happens during testing too; it is the soundbar, not the
debloat.
TP Vision telemetry. org.droidtv.gel runs inside the candeebug process. 17 TV components bind
candeebug's CollectionService (channels, playtv, settings, tptvservice, tvpowermanagerservice,
usbbreakin and others); none of them retried after it was disabled. Idle log unchanged, except
that the storage monitor's 10-minute pass now logs "TvStorageCULLogger: Binder NOT available"
once per channel source instead of handing the counts over.
